import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64,json
p=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','9','-l','9','-scale-to','1200','-singlefile','-png',str(p/'sources/nfm.pdf')],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
b=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode();z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/nfm-page9.png','--base64'],input=b,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
print(json.dumps({'png':b}))
